title: Progress pop-up windows for manual bolus immediately closed while bolus still progressing
symptom: When starting a manual bolus, the progress window pops up, immediately shows a full bar, then closes, while the bolus continues in the background. This occurs intermittently and cannot be reproduced consistently.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. MilosKozak states that closing the app by swiping destroys activities and there is no way to restore the progress pop-up, which is Android design. For the case without closing the app, no cause is identified.
fix: No definitive fix is stated. MilosKozak mentions 'i did some improvement recently but to be honest i'm not 100% sure it helps', but no specific fix is confirmed.
evidence_quote: when you close app (by swiping out) all activities are destroyed and there is no way to restore it. it's android design
